name: Kyle Richards
bio: Kyle Richards (born January 11, 1969) is an American actress and television personality. She is known for her few roles in horror movies as Eaten Alive, Halloween (1978) and The Car. She's also part of Bravo's The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills and reprised her role of Lindsey Wallace in Halloween Kills in 2021 and Halloween Ends in 2022. She graduated from Central Union High School in El Centro, California in 1987. She is also the sister of actress Kim Richards and the aunt of Paris Hilton.
